observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 is a test-only change and does not demonstrate implementation or PostHog benefit. P1.F2.H1 is an implementation change. No score is assigned because P1.F1.H1 does not establish tier, and P1.F2.H1 lacks the surrounding context and checks required to distinguish tier 2 from tier 3. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test, test_validate_credentials_handles_a_config_without_an_ssh_tunnel_field, that checks the behavior of PlanetScalePostgresSource.validate_credentials when the config lacks an ssh_tunnel attribute. It asserts that the host validation returns False and that the SSH tunnel flag passed to the underlying PostgresSource is False.
observations.posthog_connection: This could help prevent a runtime AttributeError if the credential validation path does not account for missing ssh_tunnel attributes, but the implementation is not shown, so no tier can be assigned.

observations.behavior: Replaces the inline conditional expression for the ssh_tunnel argument with a method call, self.ssh_tunnel_enabled(config).
